title: Dick Russell's day-long interview with Sidney Gottlieb

tellings.quote: has one of the only interviews, as far as I know, with Sidney Gottlieb. He spent a whole day with him.

plain: The journalist Dick Russell is said to have spent a whole day in the 1990s interviewing Sidney Gottlieb, the CIA chemist who led its mind-control experiments, at Gottlieb's house. A researcher named Greg Malatzi tells Michels this, calling it one of the only interviews with Gottlieb that he knows of. It matters because Gottlieb almost never spoke about his work.
